resources.name: carbon_by_plot
resources.description: biomass and carbon of living trees per plot
resources.extra_info: calculations cfr NFI data for the LULUCF report
resources.attention: plot 11000 (core area Kersselaerspleyn) has different tresholds for standing trees (L+D); see p. 78 in the monitoring report  https://purews.inbo.be/ws/portalfiles/portal/41050863/Vandekerkhove_etal_2021_MonitoringProgrammeOnStrictForestReservesFlanders.pdf

fields.name: plot_id
fields.description: unique sample plot id

fields.name: period
fields.description: period: "1" for 1st decade (2000-2010), "2" for 2nd decade (2011-2020), "3" for 3th decade (2021-2030)
fields.extra_info: "0" only occurs for dendro data in plot 11000 (1986)

fields.name: StemVolume_m3_ha_alive
fields.description: bole volume of living trees per ha (m³/ha): calculated using species specific volume functions based on height and diameter at breast height;  small trees excluded (dbh < 5 cm)
fields.extra_info: source: Dagnelie et al., Quataert et al., Dik, Berben; see table "tblTarieven_2ing" and "tblTarieven_1ing"; volume up to a top diameter of 7 cm

fields.name: VolumeStump_m3_ha_alive
fields.description: volume of stumps of living trees per ha (m³/ha)
fields.extra_info: a stump being the bottom 10 cm of each tree, and volume calculated as the volume of a cylinder with height 10 cm and circumference being the circumference at the bottom of the trunk; source: Dagnelie et al. (2013)

fields.name: TotalVolumeAGB_m3_ha_alive
fields.description: total volume of living trees, including stump and thin branch wood (m³/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculated using the (variable) volume expansion factors (VEF) of Longuetaud et al. (2013), based on diameter, height and tree species; derived from StemVolume_m3_ha_alive and VolumeStump_m3_ha_alive

fields.name: BiomassAboveGr_t_ha_alive
fields.description: above ground biomass of living trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculated using species-specific wood densities (same densities used as in Flemish RFI & LULUCF reporting); derived from TotalVolumeAGB_m3_ha_alive; method described in INBO A.4103; for factors/densities used, see "BiomassFactorsMethode_FRL.csv"

fields.name: BiomassBelowGr_t_ha_alive
fields.description: below ground biomass of living trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculation based on the ratio (R) of below-ground biomass to above-ground biomass (species-specific; source: Vande Walle et al. 2005); derived from BiomassAboveGr_t_ha_alive

fields.name: Biomass_t_ha_alive
fields.description: total above and below ground biomass of living trees per ha (ton/ha)

fields.name: CarbonAboveGr_t_ha_alive
fields.description: above ground carbon stock of living trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from above ground live biomass, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: CarbonBelowGr_t_ha_alive
fields.description: below ground carbon stock of living trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from below ground live biomass, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: Carbon_t_ha_alive
fields.description: total carbon stock of living trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from total live biomass, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: StemVolume_m3_ha_dead
fields.description: bole volume of dead standing trees per ha (m³/ha): calculated using species specific volume functions based on height and diameter at breast height;  small trees excluded (dbh < 5 cm)
fields.extra_info: source: Dagnelie et al., Quataert et al., Dik, Berben; see table "tblTarieven_2ing" and "tblTarieven_1ing"; volume up to a top diameter of 7 cm

fields.name: VolumeStump_m3_ha_dead
fields.description: volume of stumps of dead standing trees per ha (m³/ha)
fields.extra_info: a stump being the bottom 10 cm of each tree, and volume calculated as the volume of a cylinder with height 10 cm and circumference being the circumference at the bottom of the trunk; source: Dagnelie et al. (2013)

fields.name: TotalVolumeAGB_m3_ha_dead
fields.description: total volume of dead standing trees, including stump and (for intact trees) (thin) branches (m³/ha)
fields.extra_info: for intact trees calculated using the (variable) volume expansion factors (VEF) of Longuetaud et al. (2013), based on diameter, height and tree species; derived from StemVolume_m3_ha_dead and VolumeStump_m3_ha_dead; for snags sum of stump and stem volume, no crown

fields.name: BiomassAboveGr_t_ha_dead
fields.description: above ground biomass of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculated using species-specific wood densities (same densities used as in Flemish RFI & LULUCF reporting); derived from TotalVolumeAGB_m3_ha_dead

fields.name: BiomassBelowGr_t_ha_dead
fields.description: below ground biomass of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculation based on the ratio (R) of below-ground biomass to above-ground biomass (species-specific; source: Vande Walle et al. 2005); derived from BiomassAboveGr_t_ha_dead

fields.name: BiomassStanding_t_ha_dead
fields.description: above and below ground biomass of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)

fields.name: CarbonAboveGr_t_ha_dead
fields.description: above ground carbon stock of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from above ground biomass of dead standing trees, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: CarbonBelowGr_t_ha_dead
fields.description: below ground carbon stock of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from below ground dead biomass of dead standing trees, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: CarbonStanding_t_ha_dead
fields.description: total carbon stock of dead standing trees per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from above and below ground biomass of dead standing trees, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: VolumeLogs_m3_ha
fields.description: volume of lying deadwood per ha (m³/ha);  small fragments excluded (diameter < 10 cm or length < 1m; if diameter > 20 cm, length < 0,5m)
fields.extra_info: volume is calculated using Smalian’s formula (except for circular plots Kersselaerspleyn (2001-2065) 1st survey (2000):  volume of fallen trees is based on tariffs, and if necessary cut of at border of the plot)

fields.name: BiomassLying_t_ha_dead
fields.description: biomass of lying deadwood per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculated using species-specific wood densities (same densities used as in Flemish RFI & LULUCF reporting); derived from VolumeLogs_m3_ha (if available) or VolumeLogs_above30cm_m3_ha in combination with VolumeLIS_10_30cm_m3_ha (if available) or VolumeLIS_m3_ha

fields.name: CarbonLying_t_ha_dead
fields.description: carbon stock of lying deadwood per ha (tC/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from biomass of lying deadwood, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: plottype
fields.description: CP:  circular plot; CA: core area

fields.name: year
fields.description: year of dendro survey (year of growing season)
fields.extra_info: f.e. march 2020 becomes 2019 (start of growing season is set to May 1)

fields.name: VolumeLogs_above30cm_m3_ha
fields.description: volume of heavy, lying deadwood per ha (m³/ha), diameter above 30 cm
fields.extra_info: volume is calculated using Smalian’s formula (except for circular plots Kersselaerspleyn (2001-2065) 1st survey (2000):  volume of fallen trees is based on tariffs, and if necessary cut of at border of the plot)

fields.name: VolumeLIS_m3_ha
fields.description: volume of lying deadwood per ha (m³/ha);  small fragments excluded (diameter < 10 cm or length < 1m; if diameter > 20 cm, length < 0,5m)
fields.extra_info: volume is calculated applying the De Vries formula for Line Intersect Sampling (De Vries,  1973)

fields.name: VolumeLIS_10_30cm_m3_ha
fields.description: volume of lying deadwood per ha (m³/ha) of fragments with a diameter between 10 and 30 cm; ;  small fragments excluded (diameter < 10 cm or length < 1m; if diameter > 20 cm, length < 0,5m)
fields.extra_info: volume is calculated applying the De Vries formula for Line Intersect Sampling (De Vries,  1973)

fields.name: VolumeLogs_above40cm_m3_ha
fields.description: volume of heavy, lying deadwood per ha (m³/ha), diameter above 30 cm
fields.extra_info: volume is calculated using Smalian’s formula (except for circular plots Kersselaerspleyn (2001-2065) 1st survey (2000):  volume of fallen trees is based on tariffs, and if necessary cut of at border of the plot)

fields.name: BiomassLying_above40cm_t_ha_dead
fields.description: biomass of lying deadwood per ha (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: calculated using species-specific wood densities (same densities used as in Flemish RFI & LULUCF reporting); derived from VolumeLogs_above40cm_m3_ha

fields.name: CarbonLying_above40cm_t_ha_dead
fields.description: carbon stock of lying deadwood per ha (tC/ha)
fields.extra_info: derived from biomass of lying deadwood above 40 cm diameter, using a carbon factor of 0.5

fields.name: VolumeAGB_m3_ha_dead
fields.description: volume of deadwood per ha, both standing and lying (m³/ha)
fields.extra_info: only above ground standing volume and lying volume; above ground standing volume taken from TotalVolumeAGB_m3_ha_dead ; lying volume taken from VolumeLogs_m3_ha (if available) or VolumeLogs_above30cm_m3_ha in combination with VolumeLIS_10_30cm_m3_ha (if available) or VolumeLIS_m3_ha

fields.name: BiomassAGB_t_ha_dead
fields.description: biomass of deadwood per ha, both standing and lying (ton/ha)
fields.extra_info: standing: both above and below ground biomass

fields.name: CarbonAGB_t_ha_dead
fields.description: carbon stock of deadwood per ha, both standing and lying (tC/ha)
fields.extra_info: standing: both above and below ground carbon stock
